scope_limits: Diagnostic optimized binaries, not signed release archives.
Both builds have the same stage and Git subprocess timers; baseline has additional traversal timers.
Fresh ext4 source and slot volumes for each run. Source import precedes the timed batches.
Filesystem cache state uncontrolled. Two first-batch comparisons are not a distribution.
Second pair includes independent Git pack content digests for all sixteen Git-compatible placements.
No agent, CI workload, live GitHub, or network data benchmark.
